caption: Logs at 10 GB/day stay active for 90 days (900 GB), then archive from day 90 to day 365 at 10:1 compression (275 GB), then purge from day 365 to day 395. Notice the archive bar is the compressed 275 GB, not the raw 2,750 GB; at day 364 active plus archive is 1,175 GB, and the purge takes the day-365 log set to 0 GB.

spec.aria: A retention timeline for logs at 10 GB per day: active for 90 days at 900 GB, archived from day 90 to day 365 at 275 GB after 10:1 compression, then a purge window from day 365 to day 395 that removes the day-365 set to 0 GB; active plus archive at day 364 is 1,175 GB.
